failure_structure.note: All 126 target moments are realizable. The negative result is caused by the frozen interior affine-suction numerical realization and all-start contract, not by target moment infeasibility.

scientific_interpretation: The physical S/M target set itself is not the blocker: all 126 frozen targets satisfy the exact bounded moment realizability condition.

The preregistered interior affine-suction realization is not numerically robust across the frozen five-start contract. Only 38/126 state cases pass all-start convergence/interiority/local-Jacobian gates and only 4/126 pass the frozen profile-uniqueness requirement.

Many nonzero-moment cases have at least one high-A start that finds a highly accurate interior affine-suction solution while other frozen starts are outside the admissible suction interval and remain on the deterministic invalid-trial penalty. This is a numerical realization failure under the preregistered contract, not proof that the strictly convex bounded energy problem lacks a unique minimizer.

Even some zero-moment cases miss the extremely strict frozen coefficient-agreement gate despite nearly identical theta profiles, so C6J must not be interpreted as evidence of physical multi-valuedness of the convex energy minimizer.

Where the local manifold does qualify, the constructed Onsager metrics are positive definite and the generated head/flux rate solves have tiny stationarity/constraint residuals. Those four-state results are insufficient to qualify the family over the frozen domain.

The C6J stop rule forbids adding an obstacle solver, changing starts, choosing successful starts, changing state scaling, regularizing the metric or otherwise redesigning the solver after seeing this result.
Therefore the current FEMO realization is stopped before any hydrological trajectory. The underlying energy-dissipation identity remains useful theory but is not an admitted reduced-model closure.

next_authority.question: Should future Layer-ROM research invest in a separately justified globally robust convex/obstacle moment solver as a new pre-response family, or stop adding reconstruction machinery and redirect to purpose-dependent sufficiency of already-qualified simpler representations?
excluded_shortcuts: Do not replace the frozen five-start contract with only the successful C6J starts.
Do not add an active-bound obstacle solver as an automatic C6J repair.
Do not relax A/B/theta agreement tolerances after observing C6J.
Do not introduce metric diagonal regularization or alternate state scaling from C6J diagnostics.
Do not proceed to a blind/free-running FEMO experiment.
Do not claim that strict convexity alone establishes a numerically usable ROM.
admissible_future_read_only_options: A new, independently motivated convex-dual or obstacle realization of the physical S/M energy minimization, preregistered as a distinct numerical family before response and without reusing successful-start selection from C6J.

A synthesis/stop decision that treats repeated closure/reconstruction failures as evidence that the minimum robust Layer-ROM may require accepting a simpler purpose-limited representation rather than a universal low-dimensional replacement.
